content.comment_body: I have a small automation setup using [product_name] [version_no] [article_no] and [product_name] (2AI) [article_no]. Pressure sensors (4..20mA) are connected to the analog input module. Unfortunately, the [product_name] (2AI) [article_no] offers only 10-bit resolution, normalized to 0 to 1000. This limited resolution is unsuitable for our precision needs. Is there any way—hardware or software—to improve the resolution? Any advice? We can't switch to a different system, such as [version_no].
No, that's not feasible. [product_name] is limited to a 10-bit resolution.
If you had a [product_name] version with ModbusTCP support, you could use a device to send analog readings over the communication line. However, this setup won't update rapidly.
It's unfortunate that the limitation exists. Could you recommend an analog module using TCP/IP?

I don't personally use such devices, but I’ve heard about them among CNC enthusiasts. You'll need to source one on your own. Do you know if your [product_name] model supports ModbusTCP? If I were in your position, I would use a [version_no] PLC and set up communication between the [product_name] and the [version_no].
Yes, our [version_no] [product_name] supports Modbus TCP/IP protocol.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing challenges with the 10-bit resolution of their analog input module, which is insufficient for accurate pressure sensor measurements. There is disappointment in the module's capability, and no suitable solution within the current system was identified. Some participants mentioned possible expansion using ModbusTCP if supported, but this might not resolve hardware and speed requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are hoping for enhanced measurement resolution from analog input modules, ideally through hardware or software upgrades within their existing system.
